description: Text to video, or animate a still when `image` is given (optionally ending on `end_image`). Video takes one to several minutes, so by default this returns at once with an id for get_generation. Needs TANVO_API_KEY.

audio.description: Native sound on models that offer it

duration.description: Seconds; one of the model's options (default: the model's)

end_image.description: End frame on models that support it

image.description: Start frame: a local path or a public https URL

prompt.description: One scene: subject, action, camera movement, light and style

save_to.description: Optional folder to download the results into (defaults to TANVO_OUTPUT_DIR when set)

wait.description: Wait for the clip (up to 8 minutes)

name: generate_video
title: Generate a video
